defmodule DistCache.Client do
  @moduledoc """
  Distributed cache client with async operations and pluggable serialization.
  Supports custom codec modules for different data formats.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @default_ttl 300_000
  @max_key_length 250
  @allowed_codecs [DistCache.Codec.JSON, DistCache.Codec.MsgPack, DistCache.Codec.ETF]

  defstruct [:nodes, :ring, :codec_module, :async_tasks, :request_id]

  # --- Public API ---

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def get(key, opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:get, key, opts})
  end

  def put(key, value, opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:put, key, value, opts})
  end

  def async_get(key, opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:async_get, key, opts})
  end

  def configure_codec(codec_spec) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:configure_codec, codec_spec})
  end

  # --- Callbacks ---

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    nodes = Keyword.get(opts, :nodes, [node()])
    codec = Keyword.get(opts, :codec, DistCache.Codec.JSON)

    unless codec in @allowed_codecs do
      raise ArgumentError, "codec must be one of #{inspect(@allowed_codecs)}"
    end

    state = %__MODULE__{
      nodes: nodes,
      ring: build_ring(nodes),
      codec_module: codec,
      async_tasks: %{},
      request_id: 0
    }

    {:ok, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:get, key, opts}, _from, state) do
    with :ok <- validate_key(key),
         node <- lookup_node(state.ring, key),
         {:ok, raw} <- remote_fetch(node, key, opts) do
      decoded = apply(state.codec_module, :decode, [raw])
      {:reply, {:ok, decoded}, state}
    else
      error -> {:reply, error, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:put, key, value, opts}, _from, state) do
    with :ok <- validate_key(key),
         node <- lookup_node(state.ring, key),
         encoded <- apply(state.codec_module, :encode, [value]),
         ttl <- Keyword.get(opts, :ttl, @default_ttl) do
      result = remote_store(node, key, encoded, ttl)
      {:reply, result, state}
    else
      error -> {:reply, error, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:async_get, key, opts}, from, state) do
    task = Task.async(fn ->
      with :ok <- validate_key(key),
           node <- lookup_node(state.ring, key),
           {:ok, raw} <- remote_fetch(node, key, opts) do
        apply(state.codec_module, :decode, [raw])
      end
    end)

    new_id = state.request_id + 1
    tasks = Map.put(state.async_tasks, new_id, {task, from})
    {:noreply, %{state | async_tasks: tasks, request_id: new_id}}
  end

  def handle_call({:configure_codec, codec_spec}, _from, state) do
    case resolve_codec(codec_spec) do
      {:ok, module} ->
        {:reply, :ok, %{state | codec_module: module}}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({ref, result}, state) when is_reference(ref) do
    case find_task_by_ref(state.async_tasks, ref) do
      {id, {_task, from}} ->
        GenServer.reply(from, {:ok, result})
        Process.demonitor(ref, [:flush])
        {:noreply, %{state | async_tasks: Map.delete(state.async_tasks, id)}}
      nil ->
        {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_info({:DOWN, _ref, :process, _pid, _reason}, state) do
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  # --- Private Functions ---

  defp resolve_codec(codec_spec) when is_binary(codec_spec) do
    # Only allow explicitly listed codec modules from string input
    module = String.to_existing_atom(codec_spec)
    if module in @allowed_codecs do
      {:ok, module}
    else
      {:error, :invalid_codec}
    end
  rescue
    ArgumentError -> {:error, :unknown_codec}
  end

  defp resolve_codec(codec_spec) when is_atom(codec_spec) do
    if codec_spec in @allowed_codecs do
      {:ok, codec_spec}
    else
      {:error, :invalid_codec}
    end
  end

  defp validate_key(key) when is_binary(key) and byte_size(key) <= @max_key_length, do: :ok
  defp validate_key(_), do: {:error, :invalid_key}

  defp build_ring(nodes) do
    # Simplified consistent hashing ring
    nodes
    |> Enum.flat_map(fn node ->
      for i <- 0..63, do: {:erlang.phash2({node, i}, 2_147_483_647), node}
    end)
    |> Enum.sort_by(&elem(&1, 0))
  end

  defp lookup_node(ring, key) do
    hash = :erlang.phash2(key, 2_147_483_647)
    case Enum.find(ring, fn {h, _} -> h >= hash end) do
      {_, node} -> node
      nil -> ring |> List.first() |> elem(1)
    end
  end

  defp remote_fetch(node, key, _opts) do
    try do
      :rpc.call(node, DistCache.Store, :fetch, [key], 5_000)
    catch
      :exit, _ -> {:error, :node_unavailable}
    end
  end

  defp remote_store(node, key, value, ttl) do
    try do
      :rpc.call(node, DistCache.Store, :store, [key, value, ttl], 5_000)
    catch
      :exit, _ -> {:error, :node_unavailable}
    end
  end

  defp find_task_by_ref(tasks, ref) do
    Enum.find(tasks, fn {_id, {task, _from}} -> task.ref == ref end)
  end
end

defmodule DistCache.Codec do
  @callback encode(term()) :: binary()
  @callback decode(binary()) :: term()
end

defmodule DistCache.Codec.JSON do
  @behaviour DistCache.Codec

  @impl true
  def encode(term), do: Jason.encode!(term)

  @impl true
  def decode(binary), do: Jason.decode!(binary)
end

defmodule DistCache.Codec.MsgPack do
  @behaviour DistCache.Codec

  @impl true
  def encode(term), do: Msgpax.pack!(term)

  @impl true
  def decode(binary), do: Msgpax.unpack!(binary)
end

defmodule DistCache.Codec.ETF do
  @behaviour DistCache.Codec

  @impl true
  def encode(term), do: :erlang.term_to_binary(term)

  @impl true
  def decode(binary), do: :erlang.binary_to_term(binary, [:safe])
end
